notes.title: We are searching for BETA testers!!!
notes.content:
Hello to everyone in this crazy time.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p70HfofDfZs

Finally, our game studio has come down to the launch of BETA version.
We are looking for early access testers with VR system.
The game will be transferred through the steam store, we will give you access to limited game key.

If you want to join our friendly community then feel free to fill out the form and wait for us to contact you.
Tester application

The number of testers is limited. 

And please fallow our official channels
Discord
Youtube
Facebook
Linkedin
Instagram

And don't forget to add Zoo World VR in wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1311770/Zoo_World_VR/
